up: Retrieve compounds associated with document CHEMBL5725687 (i.e., compounds that appear in that document) and that have structural data available (SMILES). For each qualifying compound, output its ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures). Ensure no duplicate rows are returned, and include only compounds whose SMILES is not null. No row limit is required.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725687' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
